interpretation: Phase 10 §5 follow-up: the client default drug list is now derived from the capability registry instead of a hardcoded three. (four callers to five) and the matching client string, so that a diplotype produced by DRAGEN's targeted caller can be supplied beside a VCF under its own name rather than under another tool's. Both files are inside the scientific-core allowlist, so the previous evaluation no longer bound the candidate, and this rebind re-binds it. The benchmark supplies no outside calls, so that list is never read on any benchmark path; the application rerun over the same 208 individuals accordingly reproduces every scored metric, exclusion and discrepancy of both the historical benchmark and the 2026-11-07-f20 evaluation, and this rebind declares no eligibility change of its own. The only differing eligibility field against the previous evaluation is the hash of each regenerated single-sample VCF, explained by the path-bearing bcftools header shown in the representative projection. No new genotype concordance, phenotype truth or clinical claim follows.
